briefing: Markets are risk-on today with NASDAQ +1.4% and S&P 500 +0.8%. With $889 cash and 3 open slots, we deployed into RKLB, TSLA, and PCG — all showing full bullish momentum confirmation (MACD crossover, healthy RSI, price above SMA-20, volume surge) while favoring sectors we weren't yet exposed to over the crowded crypto-miner names on the list.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, on the theory that strength tends to continue in the short term. Today's picks all showed four confirming signals together — rising price, healthy RSI, a bullish MACD crossover, and a volume surge — which is a stronger signal than any single indicator alone.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資是指買入正處於上升趨勢的股票,背後的理念是短期內強勢股票往往會延續其走勢。今天選中的股票同時出現四個確認訊號——股價上升、RSI處於健康區間、MACD出現黃金交叉,以及成交量放大——比單一指標更具說服力。

market_education.summary_en: Broad risk appetite returned today, lifting both the NASDAQ and S&P 500, with technology and growth names leading the advance. Trading volume surged across many momentum names, suggesting institutional buyers stepped back in rather than just retail speculation. No single catalyst dominated; it reads as a broad continuation of the recent risk-on trend rather than one specific news event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日市場風險偏好回升,納斯達克及標普500指數同步上揚,科技及增長股領漲。多隻動能股成交量明顯放大,顯示機構資金重新進場,而非單純散戶炒作。市場並無單一主導消息,更像是近期風險偏好升溫趨勢的延續。
